about: Mochi's recorded sounds. Each clip: file (in this folder), kind (mew | meow | chirp | sleepy | purr), optional gain (default 1). Only use recordings you may use commercially (CC0, or CC BY with the credit listed below). See README.md. Made from sources/audio by tools/audio/prepare.py. Clips with "status": "candidate" play in the preview only; "reference" clips are never played (review pack only); clips with no status play everywhere. Meows are synthesized (meows.js) unless a recording is listed here for that kind; the recorded meow candidates were auditioned and not approved.
